svg.text: EM Copilot - BRD to Engineering Plan
Central Orchestrator hub -> specialist fan-out -> aggregate -> single Critic -> targeted revision -> HITL/output
No raw BRD in external logs
Specialists never call each other; Critic feedback returns through the Orchestrator only
Parses BRD, owns state, dispatches, aggregates
Controls retries, targeted revisions, max 2 cycles
Hub-and-spoke invariant: no specialist-to-specialist communication; every decision and revision route is mediated by the Orchestrator.
